title: Designated learning institutions list (post-secondary)
lineage: downloaded by the Fetch institution registries workflow; websites from the Hipo university-domains list and Wikidata where the list has none, marked on each record
notes: in scope: every post-secondary designated learning institution (one record per DLI number)
scope: Canada: every post-secondary institution on IRCC's designated learning institutions list, i.e. the institutions that may enrol international students on a study permit. The public directory shows universities, public colleges, CEGEPs, polytechnics and institutes, and private institutions with graduate programs.
manifest_notes: The DLI list gives no websites: they come from the Hipo university-domains list or Wikidata on an exact name match, and each such record says so.
